title: Patriots' Robert Kraft reveals rift with Donald Trump after not speaking to ex-friend since January 6 riots
text:
Once his friends, President Donald Trump and the owner of the New England patriots, Robert Kraft, are expected at the Super Bowl Lix in New Orleans on Sunday.
However, a meeting may be out of discussion, since Kraft, 83, admits that he has not spoken with the 78 -year Trump since the president’s supporters infiltrated in Congress on January 6, 2021.
“I was very annoying (with) what happened on January 6,” Kraft told Fox News. ‘And I haven’t talked to (Trump) since then’.
The multimillionaire executive director of the Kraft group and the Democrats for a long time did not expand his response.
The new widower recalled a moving phone call he received from Trump when Kraft’s first wife, Myra, died of ovarian cancer in 2011.
“Donald Trump became a social friend in the early 90s, when he went to Florida,” Kraft said. “And then, when my wife … died 13 years ago, he was one of the four or five people who approached me and it was very pleasant.”

Kraft was so moved so much for the gesture that he later donated $ 1 million to Trump’s first opening fund, which raised a $ 107 million record in January 2017. However, Kraft did not seem to donate to the opening fund this year, although Trump still He managed to raise a new $ 170 million record anyway.
Now, however, Kraft looks back in his donation with a little struggle.
‘The only donation I gave to him was that he called me when he was chosen, and I made a strong donation to his inauguration. I couldn’t believe it, “he told Fox.” It was like someone who was a brother of drunk fraternity became president of the United States. “
As for Tom Brady, a Trump’s unique golf friend, Kraft continued to support the incursion of the Patriots’ legend in the announcer’s cabin.
Brady has faced some criticism during the first season of his treatment of 10 years and $ 375 million with Fox Sports, but Kraft continues to support his friend and former employee.
“I think the way in which the nuances of the game has presented, the things that fans would never see, are really special and unique, and Fox was brilliant to attract him,” Kraft said.
Brady will call his first Super Bowl on Sunday when the Kansas City Chiefs and the Philadelphia Eagles face the Superdome in New Orleans.
